temporal_anchor.task_context: Refining LLM prompt fields for ATS Chatbots regarding experience years.

psychological_state.user_mood_and_tone: Methodical, correcting an AI assumption with practical domain knowledge.
psychological_state.behavioral_observations: User possesses deep practical knowledge of ATS systems (they know chatbots use strict data-type validation for numbers) and corrected the AI's attempt to be 'too conversational'.

interaction_pairing.ai_stimulus: AI injected the string '9.8 (nearly a decade)' into the config to make the LLM sound smarter.
interaction_pairing.user_reaction: User pointed out that chatbots usually ask for integer/float values, and a string with text will fail form validation.

cognitive_evolution.previous_paradigm: Make LLM strings highly conversational to sound human.
cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: For quantitative fields (like years of experience or salary), the ground-truth string MUST remain purely numeric (e.g., '9.8') so that if the LLM pastes it directly into a strict ATS input field, it doesn't trigger a validation error.
cognitive_evolution.reason_for_shift: Practical UI/UX limitations of external ATS chatbot parsers.

long_term_application: Never inject conversational text (like 'nearly a decade') into config fields that are fundamentally quantitative. Keep numbers clean for safe HTML form filling.
